dossier.scp_unleashed.217.title: The Clockwork Virus
dossier.scp_unleashed.217.caption: A subject in the observation cell during the final stage.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: The sample of SCP-217 is held in a single sealed vial inside a powered cold locker. Sealed glass is a complete barrier. The vial is opened only by staff in a complete sealed suit: hood, coat, trousers and boots. A hood alone has been tried. %rResult on file.%r

Anyone who has stood in a room with an open sample is to be swabbed and the swab read in an analyzer. A positive subject is moved to an observation cell. For a time they will be quicker and stronger than the staff sent to move them. Send staff early.
**Do not try to wind them.** Staff are to keep the subject comfortable and keep a record of the hours.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-217 is a thin orange oil recovered as a single sealed vial. Sealed, it is inert. Open, it reaches any person within sixteen metres with an unobstructed line to the sample. Solid material between the subject and the sample stops it. A hood or a gas mask does not; only a complete sealed suit has kept it out.
The condition has been called a virus since the first report, though it behaves like nothing of the kind. Subjects never pass it to one another. It travels only from the sample.

At first subjects report feeling unusually well, and they are right: they are quicker and stronger than before. This fades. Small brass fittings appear on the arms, then cogs, then springs and gears that turn by themselves, each with a faint tick. Movement grows stiff and slow, and footsteps ring like metal on stone.
By the final stage the subject is more mechanism than person, and the ticking begins to slow. %rSee Addendum 217-1.%r

page.title: Addendum 217-1: Observation Log
text: Every subject so far has come to a stop. The ticking slows over the last minute, and then there is no more of it. The log records each case in two words: wound down.
No treatment tried has turned it back. A clerk's note in the margin observes that the condition has never been seen to outlast the person carrying it.

page.title: Addendum 217-2: Provenance
text: SCP-217 was not recovered. It was handed to a reader of this file by an individual in Foundation dress, the same individual described in the files of other objects.
Asked what was in the vial, the individual checked a pocket watch and said there was still time. %rMeaning unclear.%r See field notes.

page.title: Addendum 217-3: Refined Sample
text: A second sample has been entered under this file. It reads as SCP-217 in every assay but one, and the analyzer gives it a line of its own: SCP-217-P. The oil has a fine brass sheen. Where the sample came from is not recorded.

Subjects exposed to SCP-217-P grow the same fittings at the same pace. They do not stiffen and they do not slow. They grow quicker and stronger instead, and in the final stage the ticking settles into perfect time and stays there.
One such subject reports being able to hear the room: every creature within a long stone's throw, walls or no walls. %rRequests to keep the subject on staff are under review.%r

jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp217.1: A sealed sample of SCP-217: a thin orange oil that never quite settles. While the seal holds it is completely inert.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp217.2: An open sample reaches anyone within %1$s blocks with a clear line of sight. Solid blocks stop it. A gas mask or hood alone is not enough: only a complete hazmat suit keeps it out.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp217.3: Those it reaches feel quicker and stronger at first. It does not last. Brass fittings, cogs and springs follow, and with them stiffness. Only a swab read in an analyzer confirms it early.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp217.4: Players and D-Class can be affected. The affected never pass it on: only open samples spread it. No treatment is known.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp217.query.posi: %s carries SCP-217: stage %s of %s, about %s s left
commands.scp_unleashed.scp217.hasten.suc: SCP-217 in %s hastened: about %s s left
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp217.0: A sealed sample is on its way to you. Do not open it without a full suit.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp217.1: The contact finds the reader. Stay out in the open and wait.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.vial.scp217_perfe: A sealed sample of SCP-217-P: the same thin oil as SCP-217, with a fine brass sheen that catches the light. While the seal holds it is completely inert.
An open sample reaches anyone within %1$s blocks with a clear line of sight. Solid blocks stop it. A gas mask or hood alone is not enough: only a complete hazmat suit keeps it out.

The fittings, cogs and springs come on just as they do with SCP-217, but this clockwork runs true. Those it reaches only grow quicker and stronger, and nothing in it ever winds down. Only a swab read in an analyzer tells the two apart.

Players and D-Class can be affected. The affected never pass it on: only open samples spread it. Late in its course, pressing %2$s sends a pulse through the clockwork that finds every creature nearby, even through walls.
message.scp_unleashed.scp217.pulse_awake: Your clockwork has settled into perfect time. Press %s to send out a pulse.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp217.perfect.fa: %s already carries SCP-217-P or cannot carry it
commands.scp_unleashed.scp217.query.perf: %s carries SCP-217-P: stage %s of %s, holding steady
